disambiguation: It is a note conversion tool, not a standard email client.
extras: Requires desktop operation for full functionality; mobile only reads notes already synced by desktop.
intentEvidence: Mailstone turns a mail folder on your server into notes in your vault
problem: It addresses the difficulty of integrating email correspondence directly into a structured note-taking system without losing the original message data.
